parameters.content:
## How it works
POST {"question": "...", "name": "...", "email": "..."} to the webhook.
A question that matches one FAQ entry is answered at once. Anything else goes to a person: no match, a refund or order problem, a pasted card or password, or a customer who asks for a human.

## Set up
Edit the six entries in FAQ knowledge source.
Choose your own SMTP credential on Send handoff email and change the from and to addresses (example.com placeholders).

## Fictional business
Northline Supplies is a made-up shop. Sample policies only.
